cases.name: a protocol's open chooses what the loop walks
cases.document:
kernel 1
numbers by_spelling
use list.copy = @9582e9497de80ffe91797c946b2d48fc9e1621735e02d33bf53c8c828a41d63a
use list.len = @70d92c79f9c69cfe8cda0752cf30f5f0db0499a1bbffeeed9e2abddad9cf302b
main { let xs = [1, 2] for x in xs via (open list.copy) { print x set xs[list.len(xs)] = 3 } finish xs }
